info.author: Datyeyeboi
info.name: Hydra speed
info.description: Lift the cap on topspeed for aircraft, especially Hydra. Press 1 to cycle through throttle modes (Default Throttle 1.5, Full Throttle 13.41, Turbo Throttle 30). Press 3 to toggle airbrake on/off. Use /airvel command to toggle throttle modes.
